source: William Lilly Christian Astrology original first edition 1647 Wellcome b30338724
heading: Of the significations in a Nativity, of great Fortune to be obtained out of MINES
scope: Period 1647 speculative economic-mining-commodity assertions only. No independently tested mines, geology or financial results.

groups.subject: Printed CXXVII and specialized mineral wealth scope

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXVII ... fortune ... out of MINES
claims.historical_meaning: The next numbered chapter concerns alleged wealth from metal and mineral extraction rather than personal/parental relations.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: great Fortune to be obtained out of Mines
claims.historical_meaning: Source is an outcome of economic gain from mining; not actual mineral deposits or commodity returns.

groups.subject: Saturn as fourth ruler or occupant, essential strength and favorable aspects

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn Lord of the fourth house
claims.historical_meaning: A fourth-house ruler Saturn is one alternative prerequisite for the author's general mine-wealth case.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or posited in the fourth
claims.historical_meaning: Saturn occupying fourth is an alternative to being fourth ruler, not necessarily both.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: either in his Exaltation or house
claims.historical_meaning: Essential dignity through Saturn's exaltation or domicile qualifies the positive mining branch.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: and is Direct
claims.historical_meaning: Direct motion is a separate requirement rather than always assumed.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: swift in motion
claims.historical_meaning: Saturn moving faster than its historical mean is an additional condition in the same source paragraph.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: benevolent aspect with Fortunes
claims.historical_meaning: Favorable aspect to at least one benefic forms another prerequisite for promised mineral gain.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: more potent he is more Gaine
claims.historical_meaning: Lilly scales alleged profit upward with Saturn strength rather than simply producing a yes/no forecast.

groups.subject: General material and business outcome classification

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: acquire an ample Fortune by managing Quarries and Mines
claims.historical_meaning: The combined Saturn case is said to generate substantial wealth managing mining/quarry activities; unverified.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mettals Coales Stones or Minerals
claims.historical_meaning: The general outcome category encompasses metals, coal, stones and minerals, not exclusively gold.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: more evidently effects appear
claims.historical_meaning: The source claims stronger testimony improves perceptibility of outcomes, without numeric calibration.

groups.subject: Fourth ruler with luminary reception or luminary-dispositor mutual reception

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of fourth received by either Luminaries
claims.historical_meaning: Reception of fourth-house ruler by Sun or Moon is one claimed strong mining-wealth testimony.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or Planet that disposeth either Light
claims.historical_meaning: A planet that rules either luminary is an alternative recipient or participant in this claimed method.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: with mutuall Reception
claims.historical_meaning: Mutual reception is specifically qualified and must not be erased or read as one-sided aspect alone.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: aboundance of Wealth by meanes of Mines
claims.historical_meaning: The author alleges great mining resources in the reception configurations, no independent mines studied.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Coal mines Quarries Lead mines Iron mines
claims.historical_meaning: A material list provides multiple possible mining specialties, increasing retrospective matching flexibility.

groups.subject: Jupiter in fourth Libra alleged tin and father fortune

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Jupiter in the fourth
claims.historical_meaning: Jupiter physically in fourth is the basis for this separate favorable mining case.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: in Libra
claims.historical_meaning: Lilly specifically names Libra as sign of fourth-house Jupiter for tin wealth, not an arbitrary Jupiter placement.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Wealth ... by Tyn especially
claims.historical_meaning: The source attributes tin-mining wealth in preference to other minerals for that configuration.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: good Inheritance or personall Estate from Father
claims.historical_meaning: The same condition is alleged to indicate paternal inheritance or estate; avoid counting independent financial successes.

groups.subject: Saturn Aquarius in fourth and Jupiter Libra: paired condition

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn most to be preferred
claims.historical_meaning: Lilly introduces an explicit preference for Saturn's testimony in a combined planetary-sign configuration.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn fourth house in Aquarius
claims.historical_meaning: Saturn must occupy the fourth and Aquarius in this source's preferred combination.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Jupiter shall then be in Libra
claims.historical_meaning: Jupiter in Libra is concurrently required, not a standalone substitute for Saturn's fourth-house placement.

groups.subject: Mars Leo fourth and Sun Aries for iron silver gold

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars in the fourth house
claims.historical_meaning: Mars is explicitly the fourth-house occupant for a separate mining specialty rule.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: in Leo
claims.historical_meaning: The fourth-house Mars is additionally specified in the sign Leo.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun in Aries
claims.historical_meaning: A concurrent Sun in Aries is an independent component of this rule.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Iron Mines Silver Mines or Gold Mines
claims.historical_meaning: The author allows iron, silver or gold as alternatives, not a unique specific mineral prediction.

groups.subject: Coal or lead branch with Saturn earth sign and good aspects

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn be in an earthly Signe
claims.historical_meaning: Saturn in an earth sign is a specific condition of the author's coal/lead wealth rule.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: some good aspect of Sun Mars or Mercury
claims.historical_meaning: A favorable Saturn contact with one of Sun, Mars or Mercury is additionally prescribed.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: he either in the fourth
claims.historical_meaning: At least one implicated planet being in fourth is one of two alternative house configurations.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or having a good aspect to Planets in fourth
claims.historical_meaning: A good aspect to planets located in fourth is the alternative, not necessarily direct house occupancy.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: fortunate in Coal mines or Lead Oare
claims.historical_meaning: The source alleges profits particularly from coal or lead-ore mines under the compound configuration.
